description: NaPrYSbO₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic F̅43m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent PrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent YO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent SbO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.94 Å. Pr is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form PrO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent PrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent YO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent SbO₆ octahedra. All Pr-O bond lengths are 2.94 Å. Y is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form YO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent PrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Y-O bond lengths are 2.18 Å. Sb is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent YO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent PrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Sb-O bond lengths are 1.97 Å. O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Pr, one Y, and one Sb atom.
